options.text: $+55$ means Region $T$ uses no tea at all.
$+55$ means stronger milk preference than tea for Region $T$ on that scale.
Preferring milk is settled by finding the mean of an unrelated data list.
$-55$ and $+55$ mean the same preference direction as well as the same strength.

stem:
Aarav reads an infographic of regions. A colour scale from $-100$ to $+100$ encodes the difference between per person milk use and tea use. Region $T$ is marked with value $+55$.

Which claim is correct?

teacher.key_rationale: Positive scale values mean stronger milk preference; +55 is not zero tea and is not the same direction as -55.
